_comment: Quantaureum DA (Data Availability) Committee Configuration Example
_doc: P3-4 (2026-07-15). This file documents the 'danksharding' section of the node config (node/config.go:DankshardingNodeConfig). Copy the 'danksharding' block below into your node's config.json and adjust values. Fields not listed here are not DA-related.

enabled._testnet: false (set true once validator count >= committeeSize)
enabled._desc: Master switch for the DA subsystem. When false, initDanksharding() returns immediately — no blob processing, no committee participation, no DAS sampling. Mainnet MUST set true; testnet/devnet may set false during early operation when the validator count is below committeeSize (512 default).

experimental._desc: When true, logs a warning at startup and once per block (warnOnce). Set to false for production mainnet once the DA subsystem has been audited and stabilized.

warningMessage._desc: Custom warning message shown when experimental=true. If empty, the default 'Danksharding is EXPERIMENTAL - not production-ready, use at your own risk' is used. Set this to document your organization's testing status.

committeeSize._testnet: 4 (set to your validator count, must be <= 512)
committeeSize._desc: Overrides the DA committee size. 0 = use the compile-time constant DACommitteeSize (512). For testnet/devnet with fewer validators, set this to your active validator count. The committee is shuffled from active validators each epoch using VRF beacon randomness (P1-12). Must be > 0 when enabled=true and validator count is below 512.
committeeSize._constraint: committeeSize <= len(activeValidators), otherwise GetCommittee returns 'insufficient active validators' error.

subnetCount._desc: Overrides the DA subnet count. 0 = use the compile-time constant DACommitteeSubnetCount (32). Subnets are used for distributed column-to-subnet assignment in DAS sampling. Rarely changed — leave at default 32.

_compile_time_constants._comment: These constants are NOT configurable via JSON. Changing them requires recompiling the node (and may break consensus compatibility). Listed here for operator awareness.

DACommitteeSize._desc: Default DA committee size. Can be overridden per-node via committeeSize above, but the network-wide value should be consistent.

DACommitteeSubnetCount._desc: Number of DA subnets for distributed sampling.

DACommitteeEpochLength._desc: Slots per epoch. Committee is recomputed every 256 slots (~51min at 12s slot time).

DAAttestationThreshold._desc: Minimum attestation collection rate for DA availability (2/3 supermajority).

DAMaxAttestationsPerSlot._desc: Hard cap on attestations accepted per slot. Equals DACommitteeSize. Prevents memory exhaustion from bogus ValidatorIndex flooding (P1-8).

DAMaxTransitionSignatures._desc: Max individual signatures in transition (multi-sig) mode when no QTD threshold signer is configured. Larger committees MUST use QTD threshold aggregation (P0-3).

MaxBlobsPerBlock._desc: Maximum blobs per block. ProcessBlobsForBlock rejects blocks with more.

MaxBlobStorageSize._desc: In-memory blob storage LRU cache cap. When exceeded, oldest entries are evicted.

BlobGCTickerInterval._desc: Automatic GC ticker interval for blob storage cleanup.

_retention_config._comment: DASRetentionConfig (encoding/das_retention.go) — currently uses DefaultDASRetentionConfig() and is NOT exposed via JSON. Documented here for operator awareness. Future versions may expose these fields.

BlobRetentionSlots._desc: Blobs older than currentSlot - 128 are GC'd. 128 slots ≈ 25min at 12s slot time.

MinConfidenceDecay._desc: Floor for confidence decay — confidence never drops below 50% of original within the retention window.

_how_to_disable._method_1_json: Set danksharding.enabled = false in config.json (recommended). initDanksharding() returns immediately without initializing any DA components.
_how_to_disable._method_2_runtime: Call committeeMgr.SetConfig(DACommitteeConfig{Enabled: false}) at runtime to disable the committee without restarting the node. Cached committees are cleared and GetCommittee returns ErrDACommitteeDisabled.
_how_to_disable._method_3_compile: Remove the 'danksharding' section entirely from config.json — DefaultDankshardingNodeConfig() returns Enabled=false, Experimental=true (fail-closed).

_mainnet_example._comment: Minimal mainnet config — copy this 'danksharding' block into your node's config.json

_testnet_example._comment: Testnet with 4 validators — DA committee size set to validator count

_devnet_example._comment: Devnet — DA disabled (single node, no committee)
